question.text: 'Expected Return' estimation in the IPS uses:

answer.text: Historical risk-return as a starting point plus forward-looking capital market forecasts

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook uses investor inputs plus capital market forecasts. Historical risk-return is treated as a starting point, while future risk-return opportunities are derived from forward-looking capital market forecasts. The Trap: Pure historical data can mislead because past relationships may change across market regimes. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.163 and p.173).
